style: STRICT 2D PIXEL CHIBI in cozy top-down three-quarter office game view. Oversized round skull/face at least ONE THIRD of total full-body height, independently of tall hat; head about 18 pixels tall, hat about 8 pixels tall, torso and legs about 23 pixels tall. Final subject approximately 26x49 logical pixels, fits 32x64 cell with foot anchor (16,60). Big expressive eyes with WHITE square highlights, NEVER plain dot eyes. Strong silhouette, selective dark warm-brown 1-pixel outline, 3-4 hard-edged tones per material, warm palette, deliberately chunky consistent SQUARE pixels. No soft gradients, dithering, antialiasing, vector curves, realistic proportions. Uniform pure MAGENTA #FF00FF background; no magenta in subject. No shadows, floor, scenery, grid, labels, furniture or floating marks. IDENTITY: Cheerful compact sous-chef developer with a broad pear-shaped torso and short sturdy legs. Tall narrow PAPER chef toque, slightly crooked to his anatomical right, straight folded paper sides and asymmetric flat crown, NOT a puffy cloud hat. Chestnut wavy forelock clearly visible below the hat with two outward temple tufts, warm peach face, thin dark pencil mustache ABOVE a small friendly smiling mouth. Big brown expressive eyes, EACH eye a dark 3x4 logical-pixel shape with a clearly visible 1-pixel WHITE square highlight. Broad visible face area; hat brim stays above eyebrows. White double-breasted chef jacket with two vertical columns of dark buttons and rolled elbow sleeves showing peach forearms. One warm rust-striped ivory tea towel over his anatomical LEFT shoulder, short tail hanging to waist. Charcoal and warm ivory small checkerboard trousers. Chunky dark walnut clogs. Same hat tilt, brown hair, thin mustache, rolled sleeves, double buttons, towel and checkered pants in EVERY pose.
